author: Hidayath Shaik
comment: Eid Mubarak. Wishing you and your team a peaceful holiday with your families. These moments matter because the work only has meaning when people and relationships stay at the center.

author: JOH Partners
comment: The useful signal here is execution discipline, not just the update itself. In GCC programs, the gap is usually ownership and cadence after the first decision. The best metric is the one that shows momentum 90 days later.
